author: Hacktivism
body:
This is a very unique CTW map.

Key Features:
- Players cannot place or break blocks
- Wools are obtained by walking through a portal
- Two spawns, players are spawned on random sides each time
- Permanent speed I effect for all players
- Bow shots kill instantly, sword hits do not
- You get one arrow per life; they cannot be obtained nor rewarded
- Multiple levels; underground tunnels as well
- Gold blocks drop golden chestplate when broken

replies.author: Dyspa
replies.body:
In my opinion, map devs should start listening to us, I mean, all I saw above this reply were opinions about the map being too plain and flat but, hey! That's what we're looking for. We want more space for strafing and stuff, not a bunch of structures built just for the aesthetics and a nice looking. Who cares wether the map looks nice or not? You can't have an overview of the map in survival since you're just focused on finishing the match that's being played at that moment. Implementing more structures in a map makes it laggier and starts getting a bit annoying since at least 2/10 of my deaths are caused for the trouble just mentioned. 
I don't want to start a flame war, all I want is some feedback about what I just said, I'm pretty sure some people will agree with me.

replies.author: Puysegur
replies.body: Yep, to summarise this map would be to say try and look at the creators motivation and way of thinking. If a map looks as though they put some real thought into what is going on, which this map shows, then we should trust the judgement of the creator on what structures there are and what the layout involves. This is a map that clearly shows some time and thinking went into it and regardless of the preconceived idea that all maps must be beautiful and aesthetically pleasing, Hacktivism has done what he believes is the best for his map. I personally feel that this makes the map much more enjoyable and special. I'm still +1'ing this and I don't think a thing should be changed.
